title: Dolça, daughter of the old house of Orihuela, becomes ruler of the Ṭāʾifa of Mursiyya, the ṭāʾifa the sultan is absorbing into the realm

The Spread of Usury: Muslim merchant families of the growing towns have begun to lend at interest, and the ʿulamāʾ demand that it be stopped. The sultan answers that the ʿulamāʾ are overreacting. The ʿulamāʾ lose 10% satisfaction

title: On 7 Shaʿbān 772 the treasury holds 96 dīnārs and gains 10.7 a month; the realm counts 755,000 souls, growing by 445 a month. The market of Ishbīliya stands first in the outliner's list of markets, ahead of Fās and Niani. Duʿā and Maryam are assimilating Ishbīliya and Jayyān, Castilian Patriots are in arms in the realm, and the claim to reconquer Iberia, a spy network and the annexation of Mursiyya are all under way
The claim for the Reconquest of Iberia against Qashtāla is complete. It cannot be pressed honourably before the truce ends on 5 June 1375
A son, Yūsuf, is born to the sultan and Aiman the Mamlūk, named for his grandfather
